product-risk.detail: Internal financial batch job; duplicates unacceptable; MONEY/RUN/SEC rules.

runtime-deployment.detail: Ubuntu 24.04 OS Python 3.12, synchronous CLI, cron; operational activation runbook.

responsibilities.detail: ARCH-01/02 explicit module ownership and dependency direction.

repository-structure.detail: Preserve src/ordersync and tests; patterns name future modules only when features need them.

language-conventions.detail: Decimal text construction, typing and lint checks, explicit error and formatting review.

api-contracts.detail: CONTRACT-01, HTTP-01 and S3-01 define payload compatibility, conditional writes and retry semantics. finance_key equals run_id; path parser remains a compatibility wrapper over the future bytes interface.

data-persistence.detail: RUN journal protocol, immutable CSV hash, versioned JSON run/status records, RET-01.

identity-security.detail: SEC-01 separates finance/ops archive access from ops-only status; safe configuration/logging.

frontend-interaction.detail: No UI; requested status is a private JSON object, not a public service.

background-concurrency.detail: RUN-01..04 single-host lock, durable outcomes, seven-day receiver replay constraint.

local-development.detail: OS Python/uv, locked environment, one command; no service or Docker required.

verification-strategy.detail: TEST-01 synthetic boundary/failure recipes; actual parser test and foundation negative trials.

performance-reliability.detail: Explicit initial input/run/adapter bounds and operational measurement revisit conditions.

ci-review.detail: Check-only Actions on PR/master/merge_group with ordersync-quality; external activation handoff.

build-supply-chain.detail: Locked build group, wheel check, action hashes; dependency license/advisory release review.

release-distribution.detail: Manual reviewed wheel promotion with hashes and locked runtime artifacts; no publishing.

cd-infrastructure.detail: Keep cron/manual delivery; runbook requires actual ops paths and identities before activation.

operations-recovery.detail: Ops on-call; lock, journal, reconciliation, retention verification and code-only rollback.

agent-guidance.detail: AGENTS routing, CLAUDE import, three persistent .claude skills; direct-file Codex fallback.

maintenance-handoff.detail: Explicit reassessment triggers and maintainer/ops ownership; no scheduled caretaker.
